claim: The two specified reset probabilities give different stroboscopic spin readouts in a two-spin Floquet model.
discrimination: Compare the same observable at the same period and rotation angles.
evidence_sequence: Identify the unitary period and joint reset.
Read the calculated spin expectation as a function of period.
main_text_location: Standalone example, accompanying caption beside the model definition.

layout.reason: Two spin wires share a period field, and a local return leaves room for a short time trace. The printed size and grayscale proof preserve its marker and line identities.

style_semantics: Pale blue groups the period, mauve marks a joint reset and teal marks the Z meter. The warm point locates the Ising interaction. Each trace has its own marker and line style.

panels.claim: Two spin rotations precede a symmetric Ising interaction and a probabilistic joint reset.

panels.comparison: The circuit is common to both displayed probabilities.
panels.challenge: The meter labels the readout while the local return carries the state into the next period.
